prompt.label: Easy — Policy and Procedure Discovery
prompt.userMessage: Our employees frequently struggle to find the latest version of internal policies, operational procedures, and compliance guidance across SharePoint sites and shared drives. Teams often rely on asking colleagues directly because search results are inconsistent and documents are duplicated across departments. This creates delays, especially for newer employees and regional offices that may not know where authoritative information is stored. Leadership wants a more reliable way for employees to quickly locate accurate business information without needing to understand the underlying systems.

{"action":"clarify","round":1,"message":"Got it — you want a single place where employees can ask a question and get the authoritative answer from your policies and procedures, instead of hunting across SharePoint and shared drives.

A couple of quick things:

1) How should employees interact with it?
 A) Chat-style assistant that answers in plain English with citations to source docs
 B) Search bar with filtered results (list of matching documents)
 C) Both — chat assistant plus a search/browse view

2) A few extras we can wire up out of the box — pick any that sound useful:
 A) Admin dashboard to control which SharePoint sites/libraries get indexed and see top questions
 B) Audit log of every question asked (for compliance review)
 C) Email alerts to admins when document sync or indexing fails
 D) CSV export of search history and unanswered questions (to spot content gaps)"}

parsed.message: We'll build an internal policy Q&A assistant. Employees chat in plain English and get answers with citations linking back to the original SharePoint policy documents. Admins configure which SharePoint sites and libraries get indexed, and see a dashboard of top questions, usage trends, and content gaps. Documents are ingested and re-indexed on a schedule, chunked, embedded, and stored in pgvector for retrieval-augmented answers.

tasks.summary: Stores users, configured SharePoint sources, ingested documents, and the Q&A history that powers the admin analytics.
tasks.task: Tables: users, sources, documents, questions, answers. Indexes: documents(source_id), questions(user_id, created_at DESC), answers(question_id). Column-level contract: data_model. FK ordering enforced. No extensions here (pgvector lives in vectordb scope).

tasks.summary: Holds embeddings of chunked SharePoint policy documents so the assistant can retrieve the most relevant passages for any question.
tasks.task: pgvector extension. Table: doc_chunks(id SERIAL PK, document_id INTEGER, source_id INTEGER, chunk_text TEXT, chunk_index INTEGER, sharepoint_url TEXT, embedding vector(3072), created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT NOW()). Index: HNSW on embedding (vector_cosine_ops). Embedding model: text-embedding-3-large via MGA.

tasks.summary: Express API that handles chat questions, runs retrieval-augmented answers via MGA with citations, manages SharePoint source config, and serves admin analytics.
tasks.task: Data: pg Pool from env; separate pgvector Pool on port 5433. Endpoints + bodies: api_contract. Behaviors + rules + side-effects: business_logic_contract. Auth: x-amzn-oidc-data JWT sub/email; auto-provision users row on first call; role='admin' gates /admin/*. Chat flow: embed question (text-embedding-3-large) → top-k cosine search on doc_chunks → call MGA assistant with retrieved chunks → return answer with citations[] (document title + sharepoint_url + chunk excerpt). Ingestion: scheduled job (node-cron) pulls SharePoint sources, chunks text, embeds, upserts. Validation on all POST/PUT bodies. Parameterised SQL. Uniform {error} responses with 400/403/404. List endpoints paginated (?limit=50&offset=0), newest-first.

tasks.summary: React chat interface for employees plus an admin console for managing SharePoint sources and viewing usage analytics.
tasks.task: Views + components: ui_contract. Endpoints + body shapes: api_contract (prepend /api/). Chat view is primary: message thread, input box, streamed/awaited assistant replies, inline citation chips that open the source SharePoint URL in a new tab. Admin route guarded by role from /whoami. States: spinner, empty CTA, toast on 4xx/5xx, 404 page, disabled submit during POST. Responsive.

tasks.summary: Wires the database, pgvector, backend, and frontend together for local dev and deploy.
tasks.task: Wire database, vectordb, backend, frontend. Backend env: DATABASE_HOST=database, DATABASE_PORT=5432, DATABASE_NAME=policyqa, DATABASE_USER=policyqa_user, DATABASE_PASSWORD=localdev123, VECTORDB_HOST=vectordb, VECTORDB_PORT=5433, VECTORDB_NAME=policyqa_vec, VECTORDB_USER=policyqa_user, VECTORDB_PASSWORD=localdev123. nginx.local.conf proxy /api→backend:3000. depends_on chain: frontend→backend→{database,vectordb}. Healthchecks on all services. Named volumes per db service.

mga_assistants.name: Policy Q&A Assistant
mga_assistants.description: Answers employee questions about internal policies, procedures, and compliance using indexed SharePoint documents. Always cites authoritative sources; refuses to answer when no relevant source is found.
starter_messages: What is our policy on remote work?
How do I submit an expense reimbursement?
What are the data retention requirements for customer records?
mga_assistants.instructions: Answer only from the provided retrieved policy chunks. Always include citations to the source documents. If retrieved context does not contain the answer, say so explicitly rather than guessing.
